paper_title: The ORGAN Experiment: An axion haloscope above 15 GHz
notes: ORGAN pathfinding run, a stationary (non-tunable) microwave cavity haloscope (TM020 mode, f=26.531 GHz, B=7 T, Q_L~13000). Headline 90% CL limit g_agamma = 2.02e-12 at m_a=26.531 GHz = 110 ueV, over a span of 2.5 neV shaped by the Lorentzian resonance (abstract; also Fig. 3 'ORGAN Pathfinder' bar). UNITS: the abstract writes '2.02e-12 eV^-1' but this is a typo -- Fig. 3 y-axis is explicitly labeled g_agamma (GeV^-1) and the ORGAN Pathfinder tip sits at ~2e-12 there (just below the CAST line ~6e-11), so the correct value is 2.02e-12 GeV^-1. (If it were truly eV^-1 it would be 2.02e-3 GeV^-1, far off the plot.) Central mass computed as m = 4.13567e-15 eV/Hz * 26.531e9 Hz = 1.09724e-4 eV (consistent with the paper's rounded 110 ueV). Reported as two points at the +/-1.25 neV edges of the 2.5 neV span; the Lorentzian-shaped boundary rises only ~4% across this span (2Q_L*delta_f/f0=0.30 at the edge), so it is effectively a flat line at 2.02e-12 GeV^-1. The vertical extent of the bar in Fig. 3 is the excluded region (g above the boundary), not a mass-dependent curve. Exclusion based on a 1.1-sigma cut excluding a 3.4-sigma signal, using form factor ~0.13 (untuned empty cavity). dm_density: the paper explicitly states 0.45 GeV/cm^3 for its Stage-I projections (ref [35]); the pathfinder limit follows the same analysis (as in ref [28]) and P_a scales with rho_a, so 0.45 GeV/cm^3 is recorded, though the density used for the pathfinder value itself is not stated verbatim. Figs. 4 and 5 are projections (out of scope).
